description: This file defines an abstract class 'FieldableEntity' for Drupal migrate source plugins that handle field data collection from Drupal 7 entities, including methods for retrieving fields, field values, and translation info.

classes.name: FieldableEntity
classes.description: An abstract base class for Drupal 7 source plugins that need to collect field values, providing methods to fetch field configurations, values, and translation info.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns all non-deleted field instances attached to a specific entity type, optionally filtered by bundle.

methods.name: getFieldValues
methods.description: Retrieves raw field values for a specific entity's field, optionally for a specific revision and language.

methods.name: isEntityTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if a given entity type uses Entity Translation.

methods.name: getEntityTranslationSourceLanguage
methods.description: Fetches the source language of an entity from the 'entity_translation' table, handling cases where the table may not exist.
